supersedes.reason: Explicit parent resume changes the baseline and fixes the cohort at 20 (10 desktop, 10 mobile). The previous declared_at literal 11:34:00Z was ahead of the observed 11:33:25Z clock; it was not a truthful commit timestamp. That unmeasured protocol remains unchanged on its retained branch. This corrected declaration is committed before any instrumentation or measurement.

baseline.identity_rule: Require preregistration commit/hash ancestry before candidate HEAD, unchanged frontend/backend/corpus/helper/lock bindings, clean source checkout, candidate health commit and observed local store. Hash served frontend HTML/assets against built files before and after. Retain source/runtime/tool versions independently; never describe this as an AWS release.

sampling.schedule: Preallocate slots 1..10 desktop 1440x1000 and 11..20 mobile 375x812 using existing Chromium/iPhone13 settings. One unchanged full hero helper per slot, fresh browser context/owned synthetic session; sequential desktop repetitions then mobile repetitions, same local server processes. Record actual start order.
sampling.warmup: None. No first-run discard, retry, replacement or extra attempt. Ordinary source CI is separate validation and never added to this cohort.
sampling.budget: One manual opt-in source benchmark dispatch after normal source checks and instrument negative fixtures pass. At most 20 attempted slots and 20 minutes for the benchmark process including setup/servers/finalization. Failures continue within the remaining fixed budget; timeout/cancellation retains all 20 slots. No rerun without a separately recorded parent decision.

timing.clock: Monotonic performance.now() in the browser driver; raw unrounded milliseconds.
timing.start: Immediately before invoking the unchanged hero helper trigger stage, whose first action clicks Run wrap checkpoint. Run creation and hook/surface readiness precede this boundary.
timing.end: Immediately after the unchanged close stage returns: turnover JSON matches the saved manifest, recommendations match handoff summary, wrap receipt provenance verifies and handoff contains the supplied take.
timing.included: Checkpoint, saved pickup approval/reload, ordinary-file evidence change and invalidated earlier decision, fresh role decisions, fresh wrap approval, turnover publication and verified downloads; browser/API waits and instrumentation inside the boundary. This is scripted automation completion, not human-active time or model inference time.
timing.excluded: Install/build/browser-server startup, initial navigation/run creation/hook/surface, provenance pre/postflight, clipboard extras, screenshot/video/trace recording and artifact upload. No narration holds.
timing.failure_rule: Retain started/stage/elapsed records durably before awaiting each action. Incomplete/failed elapsed is separate from successful full-workflow duration; absent time is null, never 0 success.

network_and_cost.policy: Credential-free source job; refuse browser requests outside local frontend origin and Python outbound socket/AWS client attempts with counted fail-closed guards. Use actual existing local server configuration and verify local adapters/offline interpreter/scripted planner, not a substitute API. Guard counters and identities are durably retained.
network_and_cost.model_calls: External model calls/model cost may be 0 only with complete verified offline guard evidence and no refused attempts; missing/failed guard evidence means unknown, not 0. Count scripted planner activity separately; it is not semantic AI or paid inference.
network_and_cost.no_authority: No AWS runtime benchmark, paid/provider models, mail, recording or deployment. Runtime integration belongs to parent.

reporting.raw: Preallocated per-slot durable JSON snapshots plus every raw stage/request observation: index, viewport, actual start, status, start/end/elapsed, request method/path/status/body bytes and guard deltas. Bodies, headers, session handles and arbitrary error text are excluded. Unknown byte observations remain null. Preserve failures, incomplete and NOT_RUN slots; snapshots use atomic replacement and file fsync, with finalization after timeout where possible.
reporting.statistics: Success/failure/incomplete/NOT_RUN counts over 20. Successful-duration p50 is the middle sorted value or mean of the two middle values; p95 is nearest-rank ceil(0.95*successful_n). Report successful_n with each overall/viewport/stage aggregate. Empty aggregates are null. Failed elapsed stays raw and outside successful quantiles. No exclusion, outlier trimming or inference of advantage.
reporting.retention: Always upload raw snapshots, identity/guard evidence, actual Playwright reports and readable HTML with SHA256 manifest for 90 days, including failures. Never overwrite historical measurement.json or earlier protocol/results.
reporting.limits: One bounded descriptive source-CI cohort using synthetic metadata and scripted actions. No statistical advantage, baseline speedup, real-user/human-time benefit, production/AWS latency or total-zero-cost claim. Human UAT NOT_RUN; video NOT_CONFIGURED.
